I have a suggestion on how we can gain fair and honest press coverage for GamerGate. Why don't we try reading a few articles written in your local media and find a journalist whose writing you like. In particular you should look at who consistently writes really good and well-thought-out pieces, then after lurking for a bit, contact them personally. Talk to them about what you like about their work and how you might have a story for them, a story about GamerGate.

You'll have to pitch the story about GamerGate to them, because at the end of the day, they are going to have to pitch that story to their editor. Talk to them about why GamerGate is important to you and how it's newsworthy. I highly recommend you even volunteer to set up an interview. You can also recommend they check out this post, which is a good starting point.

I think this could be a good way to get fair and honest GamerGate coverage in local media and if it works, then we can also try it with mainstream media. Always be sure to be honest and provide clear and precise examples (with citations) when talking with the journalist. Also remember that (according to the Airplay panelists) that in-person and over the phone conversations are far better than email or twitter conversations when communicating with journalists.
